name: Twilio WhatsApp Channel
description: WhatsApp channel via Twilio Business API

dmPolicy.description: Restrict who can DM the agent. 'allowlist' requires phone numbers in allowFrom; 'open' lets anyone with the bot number talk.

allowFrom.description: Phone numbers in E.164 format (e.g. +14155551234) allowed to DM the agent when dmPolicy is 'allowlist'.

groupPolicy.description: Compatibility with common OpenClaw group config. Twilio WhatsApp Business API is DM-only, so this plugin ignores group settings at runtime.

groupAllowFrom.description: Compatibility with common OpenClaw group sender allowlists. Ignored because Twilio WhatsApp Business API does not deliver group messages.

groups.description: Compatibility with common OpenClaw per-group config. Ignored because Twilio WhatsApp Business API does not support groups.

fromNumber.description: Twilio WhatsApp sender number in E.164 format.

webhookUrl.description: Public base URL where Twilio reaches OpenClaw — used for signature validation and outbound media serving.

statusCallbackUrl.description: Optional Twilio delivery status callback URL. Defaults to {webhookUrl}/webhook/twilio-whatsapp/status.

sendTimeoutMs.description: Per-attempt Twilio send timeout in milliseconds.

sendRetries.description: Maximum Twilio send attempts for retryable transport errors.

textChunkLimit.description: Maximum WhatsApp text characters per Twilio message.

mediaMaxMb.description: Maximum inbound media size in megabytes.

typingIndicators.description: Send a Twilio WhatsApp typing indicator after accepting inbound messages. Disabled by default because Twilio marks this feature as not HIPAA/PCI eligible.

typingTimeoutMs.description: Typing indicator request timeout in milliseconds.

processingAckText.description: Optional interim WhatsApp message to send when an agent run is still active after processingAckDelayMs. Leave empty to disable.

processingAckDelayMs.description: Delay before sending processingAckText while the agent is still preparing a reply.

dmHistoryLimit.description: Maximum direct-message user turns to keep in agent context. 0 or unset keeps the full session.

dmPolicy.label: DM Policy
dmPolicy.help: Who can talk to the agent. Use allowlist for personal use.

groupPolicy.label: Group Policy
groupPolicy.help: Accepted for OpenClaw config compatibility only. Twilio WhatsApp Business API is DM-only.

groupAllowFrom.label: Group Allowed Senders
groupAllowFrom.help: Accepted for OpenClaw config compatibility only and ignored by this DM-only channel.

groups.label: Groups
groups.help: Accepted for OpenClaw config compatibility only and ignored by this DM-only channel.

webhookUrl.label: Public Webhook URL
webhookUrl.help: Twilio will POST inbound messages to {webhookUrl}/webhook/twilio-whatsapp. Must be HTTPS and publicly reachable.

statusCallbackUrl.label: Status Callback URL
statusCallbackUrl.help: Optional. Twilio delivery callbacks default to the standard status endpoint under Public Webhook URL.

sendTimeoutMs.label: Send Timeout
sendTimeoutMs.help: Per-attempt Twilio send timeout in milliseconds.

sendRetries.label: Send Retries
sendRetries.help: Maximum send attempts for retryable transport errors.

textChunkLimit.label: Text Chunk Limit
textChunkLimit.help: Maximum WhatsApp text characters per Twilio message.

mediaMaxMb.label: Media Max MB
mediaMaxMb.help: Maximum inbound media size in megabytes.

typingIndicators.label: Typing Indicators
typingIndicators.help: Send a Twilio typing indicator after accepting inbound messages.

typingTimeoutMs.label: Typing Timeout
typingTimeoutMs.help: Typing indicator request timeout in milliseconds.

processingAckText.label: Processing Ack
processingAckText.help: Optional interim WhatsApp message sent if the agent is still working.

processingAckDelayMs.label: Processing Ack Delay
processingAckDelayMs.help: Delay before sending the interim processing message, in milliseconds.
